item.title: Water supply restored to Oranmore after overnight repairs
item.description: Water supply has been restored to normal levels in Oranmore this morning after the successful overnight repair of a burst water main at Tudor Vale. item.title: Weather warning for Galway on Sunday issued by Met Éireann
item.description: Met Éireann has issued a weather warning for heavy winds in Galway tomorrow, which may create a risk for motorists. A status yellow wind warning has been issued for Clare, Cork, Kerry, Waterford, Donegal, Galway, Leitrim, Mayo, Sligo, Wexford, and Wicklow. item.title: Galway county house prices up 14.8% in 12 months survey finds
item.description: The price of the average second-hand three-bed semi in County Galway rose to €310,000 in 2025, up 14.8% from €270,000 at the end of 2024, according to a national survey by Real Estate Alliance.
